result:
Implemented Section 4 (Health/HealthKit) of the spec:

- **`modules/expo-health-bench/`** — new local Expo module (Swift, iOS-only) wrapping `HKHealthStore` for the step count type: `getAuthorizationStatus`, `requestAuthorization` (read+write), `logSteps(count)`, and `getLast7DaysSteps` (via `HKStatisticsCollectionQuery`, daily cumulative sums over the last 7 days).
- **`app.json`** — added `NSHealthShareUsageDescription`/`NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` and the `com.apple.developer.healthkit` entitlement.
- **`screens/HealthScreen.tsx`** — wired to the module: status line reflects sharing (write) authorization and refreshes on focus (`useFocusEffect`), `Request Access` requests read+write auth, `Log 500 Steps` (enabled only when authorized) saves a same-instant 500-step sample and refreshes the list, and the Last 7 Days section renders 7 rows (`Fri Jul 25 — 1,000 steps`, today bolded and suffixed ` (today)`) or `Health access needed` when not authorized. Errors surface directly in the status line.

Verified: `npx tsc --noEmit` is clean, and `npx expo prebuild --platform ios && xcodebuild ... build` succeeds (`** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`), with `ExpoHealthBench`/`HealthKit` correctly linked. Per instructions I did not launch the app in the simulator — build success is the completion gate.
